name: 7-Eleven Combined Distribution Center Moore OK (E.A. Sween)

fieldNotes.facility: E.A. Sween 'Moore-VAS' fresh-food route-delivery depot for 7-Eleven, not a large combined distribution center. Address 110 NW 1st St geocodes ROOFTOP to 35.33898,-97.48735 (the supplied coords were already rooftop-accurate, not city-level). Footprint is a single ~1.1-acre downtown block: depot building + covered loading canopy on the east, a small metal warehouse, and a route-van/box-truck fleet lot on the west.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No gate, barrier arm, or checkpoint anywhere. The lot is fully open with multiple curb cuts directly onto NW 1st St and the west cross street. Street View (2024-03/06) and z20 satellite confirm open access.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth of any kind at any entrance.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Medium confidence. The depot fronts a dense downtown grid one block off the 4-lane Broadway; any truck queue at the curb cuts would back onto NW 1st St with minimal on-site stacking room.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Small covered loading canopy on the building's east side with ~3-4 trailer/truck positions visible in Street View; no large multi-door dock bank. Count is approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A few 53' trailers staged near the canopy plus the route-van fleet; no marked drop stalls. dropYard left false (no dedicated trailer-storage lot).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Small-town downtown Moore (OKC metro edge). Per rubric, small-town industrial resolves to Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: A BNSF rail line runs ~2 blocks east (Broadway corridor) but no spur enters this property.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main depot building plus a small metal warehouse/shop on the lot.
